content.text: Sikew is metazeng he Megbevayè ku,
tevaka a kenikew zutun te ked-umawa ku kenikew.
Hein nekebmerasey a zengan, midtevangan a kenikew.
Umbe ǥuntaan, pemineǥa nu is menge kebpengemuyù ku wey kehizuwi a.
Sikiyu is menge etew he egkuntada kediey,
sengemenu keluǥayad is kebpeel-elezi niw kedì?
Sengemenu keluǥayad is kebmahala niw te menge tuluuwen he wazè dan pulus wey kedsunud te ketetarù?
Tentenuzi niw he mibpilì te Nengazen is menge etew he edsunud kandin para mehimu he ǥaked din.
Tenged kayi, ebpemineǥen e zin emun ebpengumew-umew a kandin.
Emun egkepauk kew, kinahanglan he kenè kew ebpekesalà tenged dutun.
Ne emun edhizeǥè kew en diyà te menge hizeǥaan niw, pekelinawa niw is gehinawa niw ne purung kew ngunùngunù.
Sarig kew ziyà te Nengazen ne iyan niw layun ul-ulaha is kebpemuhat te hustu he menge pemuhat.
“Nengazen kehizuwi key; iyan ka metau he uzara key.
Ipeehè nu is keupiya nu kenami!”
Piru lavew pa is kelipey he ibeǥey nu kediey;
kenà is kelipey te menge etew he zekelà is keenen dan wey inumen dan.
Su iyan ka is Nengazen ed-ipat kedì,
umbe kenà a egkehandek su wazà ebpekekaid kedì minsan dutun te timpu te kedlipezeng ku.
